params.title: Activation of Shelter b13 and Evacuation of b2
params.rationale: Facility b13 has been inspected and verified safe (inspection-1) with a capacity of 300. It requires 2 staff, 60L of water, 1 sanitation unit, and 1 energy source (10kW, connector A) to operate. The plan sources these from org0, org2, org1, and org3. Once activated, it can address the shelter need at b2 (need-case-2) for 50 people.
params.benefit: Provides safe shelter for 50 people from b2, utilizing a verified facility and coordinated resources from multiple organizations.
